# AI Pose Gallery · 中文版

> 288 组 / 1439 张 AI 人体姿势参考图，日文数据完整汉化，附可直接部署的响应式静态画廊。

![画廊预览](docs/preview.jpg)

<details><summary>手机端预览</summary>

![手机端预览](docs/mobile.jpg)

</details>

**在线演示：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/>
**原始站点：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/>
**原作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

---

## 这是什么

原站是一套面向 AI 绘画 / 3D / 摄影参考的姿势图库，元数据全部为日文，且不提供批量素材下载。本仓库做了三件事：

1. **全量镜像** —— 1439 条记录对应的 1439 张缩略图（JPG 300×400）与 1439 张原图（PNG 900×1200）全部落地，共 2878 个文件 / 659.5 MB。
2. **完整汉化** —— 日文字段逐条译为中文，覆盖 4 个体系、26 个分类、288 个姿势名、5 个视角，零遗漏。
3. **可用的前端** —— 零依赖响应式画廊，完整实现原站的分类筛选、多角度切换、分组浏览、灯箱导航与原图下载，并针对手机重新设计布局。

## 页面功能

- 4 个体系页签，显示各体系的图片数与姿势组数
- 姿势名、编号、ID、分类关键词搜索，支持 `/` 快速聚焦
- 动作分类、5 种视角组合筛选，可一键重置
- **按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式，分组卡片带多角度缩略图
- 悬停或点击缩略图切换主图角度，点击卡片打开灯箱
- 灯箱先显示缩略图、再加载 900×1200 原图，支持直接下载 PNG、复制 ID、新窗口打开
- `← / →` 切换角度，`↑ / ↓` 切换姿势，`Esc` 关闭；手机支持左右滑动
- PC 多列网格、手机双列网格，移动端筛选面板可展开/收起
- 使用指南与注意事项弹窗，页脚标注图片来源与维护者链接

## SEO 与分享

页面内置了完整的 SEO 与社交分享配置：

- 关键词化标题：`AI 姿势参考库｜288 组人体姿势 · 1439 张多角度参考图`
- 独立 description、keywords、author 与 `max-image-preview:large`
- `canonical` 指向正式域名，避免自定义域名与 pages.dev 域名重复收录
- Open Graph / Twitter Card 使用 1200×630 的 `og-cover.jpg`
- JSON-LD 结构化数据：`WebSite` + `ImageGallery`，声明语言、简介与页面主图
- `robots.txt` 放行全站并声明 sitemap，`sitemap.xml` 指向首页
- 语义结构：单一 H1、分区 H2、卡片 H3；缩略图 `alt` 含姿势名与视角，图片懒加载

仓库中的绝对地址统一指向 `https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/`。Fork 后如使用其他域名，需同步替换 `index.html` 的 canonical、`og:*`、`twitter:*`、JSON-LD，以及 `robots.txt`、`sitemap.xml` 中的地址。

## 数据规模

| 体系 | 条数 |
| --- | ---: |
| 全身单人・标准系 | 365 |
| 全身单人・性感系 | 399 |
| 上半身单人 | 400 |
| 双人缠绵 | 275 |
| **合计** | **1439** |

每条记录对应 5 个视角中的若干个：正面 / 斜侧 / 侧面 / 俯视 / 仰视。

## 目录结构

```
.
├── index.html              # 单页画廊（零依赖，直接打开即可）
├── robots.txt              # 搜索引擎抓取规则
├── sitemap.xml             # 站点地图
├── og-cover.jpg            # 1200×630 社交分享封面
├── data/
│   ├── pose.json           # 原始日文数据（1439 条，未改动）
│   ├── pose-zh.json        # 中文数据（前端实际读取，含检索字段）
│   ├── meta.json           # 原始体系分类
│   ├── meta-zh.json        # 中文体系分类
│   └── translations.csv    # 日⇄中对照表（323 条，便于校对）
├── thumbs/                 # 缩略图 1439 张 JPG 300×400（22 MB）
├── img/                    # 原图 1439 张 PNG 900×1200（637 MB）
├── scripts/
│   ├── download.py         # 并发下载器（48 线程 / 断点续传 / 自动重试）
│   ├── i18n.py             # 日译中词典（唯一值去重后的 323 条译文）
│   ├── apply_translation.py# 回填译文，生成中文数据
│   ├── verify.py           # 校验文件完整性（存在性 / 大小 / 图片头）
│   └── build.sh            # 生成 Cloudflare Pages 发布目录 dist/
├── docs/                   # README 页面预览图
├── _headers                # Cloudflare Pages 缓存策略
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 数据结构

`data/pose-zh.json` 字段说明：

| 字段 | 原日文字段 | 示例 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | — | `full_sexy_P001_front` | 唯一标识 |
| `体系` | `系統` | 全身单人・性感系 | 4 大类 |
| `姿势编号` | `ポーズ番号` | `P001` | 80 组编号 |
| `分类` | `分類` | 站姿 | 26 类动作 |
| `姿势名称` | `ポーズ名` | S形站姿・胯部侧顶 | 288 种描述 |
| `角度` | `アングル` | 正面 | 5 种视角 |
| `缩略图` | `サムネ` | `thumbs/…jpg` | 相对路径 |
| `原图` | `原寸` | `img/…png` | 相对路径 |
| `检索` | — | 拼接串 | 供前端模糊搜索 |

原始日文数据 `data/pose.json` 保持原样，字段名与站点接口一致，便于对照或回灌。

## 本地预览

画廊通过 `fetch` 读取 JSON，需要 HTTP 环境（直接双击 `index.html` 会被 CORS 拦截）：

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

页面支持体系/分类/视角组合筛选、关键词搜索、分组与逐张浏览、多角度缩略图、懒加载、灯箱原图下载、键盘与触屏导航。

## 脚本用法

```bash
# 重新拉取全部图片（已存在的文件自动跳过，可反复执行）
python3 scripts/download.py
WORKERS=64 python3 scripts/download.py   # 调整并发

# 修改 scripts/i18n.py 中的译文后，重新生成中文数据
python3 scripts/apply_translation.py

# 校验 2878 个文件是否完整
python3 scripts/verify.py
```

## 部署到 Cloudflare Pages

仓库为纯静态站点，无框架、无依赖。

**方式一：GitHub 自动部署（推荐）**

1. 登录 Cloudflare Dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** → **Connect to Git**
2. 选择本仓库 → 生产分支 `main`
3. 构建设置照抄：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Framework preset | `None` |
   | Build command | `bash scripts/build.sh` |
   | Build output directory | `dist` |

4. **Save and Deploy**，约 2–5 分钟得到 `https://<project>.pages.dev`
5. 之后每次 `git push` 自动重新发布

> ⚠️ **不要**把 Build output directory 直接填 `/`。仓库根目录含 `.git`（数百 MB），
> Cloudflare 会把它当静态资源扫描，pack 文件超过 25 MiB 单文件限制会导致构建失败。
> `scripts/build.sh` 只拷贝 `index.html`、`_headers`、`data/`、`thumbs/`、`img/` 到 `dist/`。
> 若确实想用根目录，仓库已附 `.assetsignore` 兜底排除非站点文件。

> 站点限制：单文件 ≤ 25 MiB、每次部署 ≤ 20,000 个文件。本仓库最大文件 917 KB、共 2883 个文件，均在限制内。

**方式二：命令行直传**

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ai-pose-gallery-zh
```

`_headers` 已为 `img/`、`thumbs/` 配置一年期强缓存，图片不会重复回源。

## 内容提示

图库包含成人向姿势参考（部分分类名称涉及性行为术语），仅供艺术创作、动作参考与前端技术学习使用。请勿用于违法用途。未成年人请勿访问。

## 版权与致谢

- **图片与原始数据的著作权归原作者ギア所有**，来源地址见页首
- 本仓库仅为个人学习、汉化与静态站点实践存档，**不对图片主张任何权利**，也不构成对原作品的商业使用授权
- 若原作者认为本仓库侵犯其权益，请通过 Issue 联系，将立即删除相关内容
- `scripts/` 与 `index.html` 的代码以 MIT 协议开源（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)），该协议**不覆盖** `img/`、`thumbs/` 与 `data/` 中的图片和原始数据

items.name: anymove
items.description: Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.
items.readme:
**@patch_gg** · dragon, giant spider, fire demon, wolf · one AI clip per move, $0.26 each, read and fitted in under a minute. anymove turns one AI video into an animation for any rigged creature, wings, tails and eight legs included. A video model films the creature from two cameras in one frame, front on the left and side on the right. A joint reader trained on that one creature finds every joint in both views. A joint sits at the same height in both, so the pair pins it in 3D, and the rig is fitted to those joints frame by frame and exported as a GLB. The method is [@CanItCode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AS92HYsEBqo)'s; the MiniMax H3 LoRA step is [@Graalitoo](https://x.com/Graalitoo/status/2112548557576380659)'s idea. This repo is our working version of both, with the agent skills to run it. ## how it works. | | | |---|---| | | **1 · a 3d model.**
One picture becomes a textured mesh at real size.
flux 3 picture, tripo h3.1 mesh · $0.40 | | | **2 · a skeleton.**
Bones placed on grid views, skinned in Blender.
42 bones: legs, wings, tail | | | **3 · limb colours.**
Every limb its own colour, so left and right never swap.
6 limbs, 6 colours | | | **4 · two cameras.**
One camera at the front, one at the side, both views in one frame; a video model animates both at once from a prompt.
minimax h3 max on fal · 5 s, $0.26 | | | **5 · teach a reader.**
A vision model learns this one dragon from random poses whose joints are known; its average miss falls from 40 px to 6 px.
dinov2 · 2,200 poses · 20 min on one gpu | | | **6 · read every joint.**
The reader finds every joint in both views, in every frame.
50 joints · 10 s a clip | | | **7 · two views, 3d.**
Stand the two views up as walls at a right angle: each joint is where its two lines meet. The front gives side to side, the side gives nose to tail.
x from the front, y from the side, z from both | | | **8 · the rig follows.**
The rig bends its bones onto the points, ignores the strays, and exports for any engine.
glb, 24 fps, no hand edits · under a minute a clip | [docs/PIPELINE.md](docs/PIPELINE.md) has the file-by-file version. ## quick start. You need an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA (24 GB to train a reader; reading and fitting need much less), Python 3.11, [Blender](https://www.blender.org) 5.x on your `PATH` (or `BLENDER=/path/to/blender`), and a [fal](https://fal.ai) key to make new clips. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Patch-gg/anymove && cd anymove python3.11 -m venv .venv .venv/bin/pip install torch==2.11.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt cp .env.example .env # then add your FAL_KEY; git ignores .env ``` Fit the dragon's roar on the CPU, no Blender or downloads needed. The repo carries the joints its reader found in the clip; this fits the rig to them (about 20 seconds) and prints how well the two views agree: ```bash mkdir -p runs/dragon/clips/roar MOCAP_CREATURE=assets/dragon .venv/bin/python -m mocap.solve examples/dragon_roar/det.npz \ assets/dragon/rigged/rig_info.json runs/dragon/clips/roar/motion.json ``` The whole capture, from the AI clip to a GLB, with an example creature's mesh, trained reader and clip from the [release](https://github.com/Patch-gg/anymove/releases/tag/examples-v1) (13 MB mesh, 355 MB reader, 4 MB clip): ```bash tools/fetch_examples.sh dragon --readers --clips tools/prep.sh dragon && tools/rig.sh dragon # real size, skeleton, skin, limb paint, reference frame tools/capture.sh dragon runs/dragon/videos/roar/s1/h3max.mp4 roar # runs/dragon/clips/roar/render/animation.glb, and showcase.mp4 to compare it with the clip ``` A new move for the same dragon (two clips, about $0.52 on fal): ```bash .venv/bin/python tools/make_prompt.py assets/dragon "the dragon whips its tail from side to side, then stands still." prompts/dragon/tailwhip.txt tools/film.sh dragon tailwhip h3max 1,2 tools/capture.sh dragon runs/dragon/videos/tailwhip/s1/h3max.mp4 tailwhip ``` ## your own creature. Copy the closest example in `assets/` (wolf: four legs; dragon: four legs and wings; spider: eight legs; demon: two legs, two arms, wings and a tail), put your mesh at `assets//model.glb`, and work through: ```bash tools/prep.sh # set "prep" in creature.json first: real size, facing -Y # place joints in assets//rig.json on the grid views; check with: tools/rig.sh preview tools/rig.sh # build, skin, paint, reference frame tools/dataset.sh # 2,200 random poses, about 25 min tools/train.sh # the joint reader, about 20 min tools/film.sh # after tools/make_prompt.py writes prompts//.txt tools/capture.sh runs//videos//s1/h3max.mp4 ``` The skills below walk an agent (or you) through each step, with the checks that tell a good capture from a bad one. ## agent skills. anymove is a [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com) plugin and its own marketplace: ``` /plugin marketplace add Patch-gg/anymove /plugin install anymove@anymove ``` | skill | for | |---|---| | `anymove` | the method, setup, which step comes next, costs | | `anymove-rig` | mesh, facing and scale, placing joints in rig.json, building and painting the rig, framing | | `anymove-film` | writing the prompt, generating clips on fal, checking them before capture | | `anymove-reader` | rendering the dataset, training the reader, the exam in centimetres | | `anymove-capture` | reading, fitting, the quality gates, fixing bad fits, showcase renders | | `anymove-lora` | training and testing the MiniMax H3 LoRA on fal | They're plain [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) (`skills//SKILL.md`), so other agents can load them from that folder too. ## results. | creature | skeleton | reader error, front / side (px) | how well the views agree (1 = same footfalls) | |---|---|---|---| | wolf, 1.6 m | 30 bones, 36 joints | 6.9 / 3.8 | trot 0.94 · exam: 0.94 cm mean 3D joint error | | dragon, 3 m | 42 bones, 50 joints, wings | 6.2 / 5.5 | take off 1.00, roar 0.93, swipe 0.85, walk 0.81 | | giant spider, 2.4 m span | 28 bones, 40 joints, 8 legs | 2.9 / 3.6 | rear up 0.99, bite 0.96, pounce 0.89 | | fire demon, 3.6 m | 38 bones, 46 joints, wings, tail | 8.4 / 9.4 | wing beat 0.99, slam 0.84, roar 0.73 (feet planted) | Reader error is the held-out mean on the 720-row frame; the demon stands 412 px tall, so its 8.4 px is about 2% of its height. Every clip in the table is MiniMax H3 Max. The exam renders a made-up motion with known joints in the same studio and reads it back. ## what it costs. | | | |---|---| | a mesh, Tripo H3.1 with HD texture | $0.40 | | a 5 s two-camera clip, MiniMax H3 Max | about $0.26 (H3: $0.30) | | training renders, 2,200 poses x 2 views | about 25 min on one RTX 4090 | | the joint reader, 20 epochs | 17-20 min, 12 GB | | reading a clip / fitting it | 10 s / under a minute (20 s for the dragon's roar on a CPU) | | the H3 LoRA, 1,200 steps on fal | about $12, about 2 h | Prices on fal as of October 2026. ## limits. - **Eight-legged walking doesn't fit.** The two views disagree about which legs are up (0.36-0.49). Big single gestures work best: rearing, roaring, slamming, taking off, pouncing. - **Lying down doesn't fit.** The reader learns from random poses inside the joint limits, which don't include lying on a side; the wolf's death and lie-down clips failed. - **Skeletons are placed by hand** on grid views (`tools/prep.sh`, `tools/rig.sh preview`). UniRig could do it; its install pulls prebuilt flash-attn wheels. - **Video models drift.** Plain MiniMax H3 swapped the limb colours on 2 of 5 wolf clips; with the LoRA, 0 of 5 (one seed per move: a first read, not a benchmark). Seedance 2.5 played the views out of step on a trot. - **The LoRA's data is AI-derived.** Its training clips re-render motions solved from AI clips, so the halves are in sync by construction but the motion itself is AI-made. Real dog mocap exists (AI4Animation) under a non-commercial licence. - **Ground contact is wolf- and dragon-shaped.** The solver's ground term knows paw names `fpaw`, `ftoe`, `hpaw`, `htoe`; other creatures fit without it. - **Fur and cloth** need extra bones: springs (`apply_motion.py --springs`) or tracked tips (the wolf's tracked fur read 7-28° swings from the video). ## licence. Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The Patch name, mark, wordmark and Patch Pixel belong to Patch and aren't covered by it. Other companies' marks in this README belong to their owners and are shown only to credit their tools (icons from [lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), MIT, and [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org), CC0). MiniMax H3's open weights carry a community licence and hosted use on fal goes through fal's terms: check both before shipping what you make with them. The wolf LoRA in the release (`lora-wolf-twocam-h3.safetensors`) is a LoRA on MiniMax H3, so MiniMax H3's community licence applies to it, not Apache-2.0. ## credits. - The two-camera method is [@CanItCode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AS92HYsEBqo)'s, and the H3 LoRA step is [@Graalitoo](https://x.com/Graalitoo/status/2112548557576380659)'s. - DINOv2 by Meta (with registers, Apache-2.0) is the reader's backbone. - Tripo H3.1 made the meshes, from concept pictures by Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3. - MiniMax H3 and H3 Max made the clips, all run on fal. - Blender rigs, renders and exports everything. - Made by [Patch](https://patch.gg) ([@patch_gg](https://x.com/patch_gg)).

# Gears of War Native - PC ports of Gears of War 2, Gears of War 3 and Gears of War: Judgment

**PLEASE FOR NOW MAKE SURE TO USE THE LATEST TITLE UPDATE FOR EACH GAME**

**Fully Playable** with a FEW hiccups. If you come across any PLEASE upload a log and I'll try to get to it!

Hello all, I'm Shagg and I'm building a launcher for **native Windows versions** of three(eventually four) Xbox 360 games, built by static recompilation,
with a launcher called **COGBox** that sets up your own copy of each game and starts it.  These games were one of my favorite franchises so this
project is near and dear to my heart.  Gears of War 1 is currently not a priority because there's about 5 versions (it feels like) that are available
natively to PC.

**[Download the latest release](https://github.com/Shagg88/COGBox/releases/latest)** · You need your own copy of
each game. No game files are included or ever will be.

> This is an unofficial fan project. It is not made by, endorsed by or connected to Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios,
> The Coalition, Epic Games or People Can Fly. "Gears of War", "Xbox" and "Xbox 360" are trademarks of Microsoft.

---

## What it is

The games' original Xbox 360 code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled into ordinary Windows programs -
no emulator interprets the game while you play. The parts the console's hardware did are supplied by our code,
most importantly **our own renderer**, which draws every frame on Direct3D 12 (or Vulkan, experimental). That gives
the ports what an emulator can't easily offer:

- **Any resolution** - 1x to 4x the original (up to 5K) or matched to your monitor, with real extra detail, not a
  stretched picture.
- **Anti-aliasing and upscaling** - SMAA, AMD FSR, NVIDIA DLSS and Intel XeSS, including upscaling modes for weaker GPUs.
- **High frame rates** - the 30 fps limit lifted, vsync with a cap matched to your monitor, AMD FSR frame
  generation (highly experimental for now).
- **Smooth play** - the games' shaders are translated straight to Direct3D 12 shader code in under a millisecond each
  (as Xenia Canary does), kept on your PC, and pipelines are made in the background - a new area shows a moment
  later instead of freezing the game.
- **Vulkan (experimental)** - a choice on each game's Graphics tab, for testing; close to Direct3D 12 already.
- **Lower input lag** - one frame in flight, NVIDIA Reflex / AMD Anti-Lag 2 where your GPU has them.
- **HDR10**, **ultrawide 21:9**, **16x anisotropic filtering**, field of view, and the games' own motion blur, depth of
  field and lens flares as switches.
- **Split-screen** (Gears 2), **keyboard and mouse**, **Xbox and PlayStation controllers**, **title updates**,
  **chapter select**.
- **In-game menu** - Back + Start (Share + Options on PlayStation, or F1) during play: change settings, restart to
  apply them, or quit.

## The games

| Game | Version the port is made for | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Gears of War 2 | US disc (0.0.0.5) + Title Update 6 | Every chapter plays in testing; Title Update 6 is the default and fastest build |
| Gears of War 3 | Disc + Title Update 6 | Playable; Title Update 6 is the default |
| Gears of War: Judgment | Disc + Title Update 4 | Playable |

"In testing" means on the developer's PC (an RTX 3080 Ti) and scripted test runs through the chapters.
Other hardware hasn't been tried yet - please report what you find.

## COGBox, the launcher

- The three games as boxes on a carousel; box art and backgrounds from the open
  [x360db](https://github.com/xenia-manager/x360db) archive, downloaded only when you press **Get box art**.
- **Add your copy**: drop your disc image (.iso), Games on Demand copy, title update package or extracted game folder
  onto the window. COGBox recognises the game, unpacks it next to itself and checks it is the right release.
- A settings page per game with every option explained (rest the mouse on an option for its description).
- Play time, plain-English messages when a game closes unexpectedly, one-click problem reports, save backups.
- Updates itself from this page's releases: an **UPDATE TO ...** button appears when a new version is out.
- Works fully with a controller - Xbox or PlayStation (its button names switch to Cross / Circle / Square / Triangle).
- Grows with its window, and has a **borderless** option (its own minimise / maximise / close).

---

## What you need

- **Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit** - or **Linux / Steam Deck through Proton** (experimental, see below).
- **A CPU with AVX2** (Intel Haswell / AMD Ryzen or newer - roughly 2013 on).
- **A DirectX 12 graphics card.**
- **Your own copy of the game**, as a disc image (.iso) of the disc, a Games on Demand copy from your console, or a
  folder with the disc's files you extracted yourself.
- For Gears 2 and 3, the last **title update** (Title Update 6) is recommended. It's a file on a console that has
  played the game online, in `Content\0000000000000000\<title ID>\000B0000\`
  (Gears 2: `4D53082D`, Gears 3: `4D5308AB`, Judgment: `4D530A26`).
- About 8-16 GB of free space per game if COGBox unpacks a disc image for you.

## How to play

1. Download `COGBox-<version>.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/Shagg88/COGBox/releases/latest).
2. Unzip the **whole** folder somewhere you can write to, e.g. `C:\Games\COGBox` (not Program Files).
3. Start `CogBox.exe`. The programs aren't code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" - choose
   **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
4. Turn to a game and press **ADD YOUR COPY** (or drop the file on the window). Then add the title update the same way.
5. Press **PLAY**. **SETTINGS** has the graphics, frame rate, controls and gameplay options.

**Controls in COGBox:** the D-pad (or the arrow keys, the mouse wheel) turns the carousel; LB / RB choose Play or
Settings and A presses it; X opens settings, Y gets box art. On a settings page LB / RB change tab, D-pad down past the
last option reaches Library / Save / Play, and B jumps to Library.

**PlayStation controllers** work too - COGBox shows Cross / Circle / Square / Triangle and L1 / R1 instead.

**In the game:** Back + Start (Share + Options on PlayStation, or F1) opens the in-game menu - the same settings, **Resume**, **Restart to apply** and
**Quit game**. Most settings take effect when the game restarts; Restart to apply does that for you.

**Graphics API:** Direct3D 12 is the default and the tested renderer. **Vulkan (experimental)** is on each game's
Graphics tab - FSR / DLSS / XeSS and frame generation are Direct3D 12 only. Problem reports from Vulkan help a lot.

**Linux and Steam Deck (experimental):** unzip COGBox in your home folder, add `CogBox.exe` to Steam as a non-Steam
game, and in its Properties > Compatibility force **Proton Experimental** (or a recent Proton / GE-Proton). On a small
screen like the Deck's, COGBox starts maximised and borderless. Under Proton it skips exclusive fullscreen, Reflex and
Anti-Lag. Both Direct3D 12 (through vkd3d-proton) and Vulkan can be tried. Untested on real hardware yet - reports
very welcome.

**Updating:** use the update button on any game's About tab, or unzip a new release over the old folder. Your games,
saves and settings are not in the zip, so they are kept.

## If something goes wrong

- If a game closes unexpectedly, COGBox says what happened and offers a **problem report**: one zip on your desktop
  with the log, your settings and a description of your PC - no saves, no game files, your Windows user name removed.
  Nothing is sent anywhere by itself.
- Open an [issue](https://github.com/Shagg88/COGBox/issues), say what you were doing, and attach that zip.
- Common causes: a CPU without AVX2 (the game can't start), an outdated graphics driver, a different release of the
  game than the one the port is made for (COGBox warns about this when you add it).

---

## Legal

- **No game content is included.** Not in the downloads, not in this repository's code or history. You supply your
  own copy, and COGBox checks it.
- **Please only use a copy of the game you own**, and don't share game files, disc images or anything extracted from
  them - here or anywhere. Issues or pull requests containing game files will be removed.
- **What this project contains:** our own code (MIT licence, see `LICENSE`) and pieces of the Xenia emulator projects
  (BSD-3-Clause); the release adds the rexglue SDK runtime (BSD-3-Clause) and the vendors' own upscaler libraries (NVIDIA DLSS,
  AMD FidelityFX, Intel XeSS) and the DirectX Shader Compiler under their own licences. Every licence is in
  `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and in the release's `licenses` folder.
- **Box art and backgrounds** are not included; COGBox downloads them from the x360db archive only when you ask, onto
  your own PC.
- This project is offered for preservation and personal use, as is, with no warranty. It is not legal advice, and the
  rules differ by country.

---

## What's coming

Plans, not promises:
- **Gamer Tag Login**
- **Mod and Texture Pack Loader**
- **Mac, Linux, Steamdeck** - Linux and Steam Deck through Proton are in as experimental now; tested support next.
- **Online Co-Op** - Hopefully.
- **Vulkan as the default** - it's already a choice (experimental); next: matching Direct3D 12 everywhere, then default.
- **Better frame generation** - an OptiScaler-style frame generation to replace today's experimental AMD FSR one.
- **Background art read from your own copy of each game** inside COGBox.
- **Multi-core rendering** (the next step of the speed work) and shaders built at the main menu, for no first-visit hitches.
- **DLSS Frame Generation and DLSS 4/5 features** through NVIDIA Streamline on the cards that support them.
- **More controllers (Switch and others), button remapping and an accessibility section** in COGBox.
- **Achievements**, kept locally.
- More of the Gears series.

## Thank you

This project stands on the work of many open-source projects and their communities. Thank you to:

- **[Xenia](https://xenia.jp)** - Ben Vanik and the Xenia contributors, and the **Xenia Canary** and **Xenia Edge** forks.
  Their open code and years of research into the Xbox 360 made this possible; much of our renderer's exact behaviour,
  its texture and resolve rules, and the fast shader translation follow their work.
- **rexglue SDK** - the static-recompilation toolchain and runtime the ports are built
  with (Xenia-derived).
- **[SDL3](https://libsdl.org)** - windows, controllers (Xbox, PlayStation and more) and input, in the games and COGBox.
- **[Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui)** - the COGBox launcher and the in-game menu.
- **[SMAA](https://github.com/iryoku/smaa)** - Jorge Jimenez and co-authors, the anti-aliasing.
- **[xxHash](https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash)**, **[miniz](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz)** and
  **[stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb)** - fast hashing, zip files and images.
- **[DirectX Shader Compiler](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler)** and the
  **[Vulkan Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers)** - Microsoft and the Khronos Group.
- **AMD FidelityFX (FSR)**, **NVIDIA DLSS** and **Intel XeSS** - the upscalers, under their vendors' own licences.
- **[Xenia Manager](https://github.com/xenia-manager)** and its **[x360db](https://github.com/xenia-manager/x360db)**
  archive - the box art and backgrounds COGBox downloads.
- The **Gears community patches** - ultrawide by boma and TudorHorse, ported here as switches.
- **[NVIDIA FLIP](https://github.com/NVlabs/flip)** - the picture comparisons in our test runs.
- The **Anton** and **Barlow** fonts (SIL Open Font License).

Every licence is in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and in the release's `licenses` folder. If we've missed anyone, please
open an issue and we'll add them.

## How it's made

- Static recompilation with the rexglue SDK toolchain (a Xenia-derived runtime), clang 23.
- A four-layer design so every game shares the work: the Xbox 360 GPU (our renderer), the console's D3D library
  version, Unreal Engine 3, and each game.
- Built and tested with a scripted test harness: chapter starts, scripted controller input, frame captures compared
  with NVIDIA FLIP, and unit tests.
- Credits: the [Xenia](https://xenia.jp) project and its Canary / Edge forks, whose open code and research made the
  renderer's exact rules possible; the community Gears patches (ultrawide by boma and TudorHorse) ported as switches;
  Xenia Manager's x360db for artwork; AMD, NVIDIA and Intel for their upscalers.

Repository layout - one folder per game, side by side (the folder names matter: Gears 3 and Judgment build against
`../Gears2-Native`):

- `Gears2-Native/` - Gears of War 2, the shared renderer and runtime layers (`src/layer0_xenos` and up), the COGBox
  launcher (`cogbox/`), the unit tests and the toolchain notes (`notes/30`).
- `Gears3-Native/` - Gears of War 3 (layers 2-3 for its engine and game, its SDK patches in `patches/`).
- `GearsJ-Native/` - Gears of War: Judgment.

Each folder has `src/`, `tools/` (build and test scripts; `tools/build.ps1` builds) and `notes/` (design notes and
decisions log). Building it yourself needs your own game copy and the toolchain in `Gears2-Native/notes/30`.

## Where things are (on the PC)

`C:\COGBox` is the whole project in one folder:

| Folder | What | In git |
|---|---|---|
| `Gears2-Native\`, `Gears3-Native\`, `GearsJ-Native\` | Each game's port: source (`src`, `tools`, `notes`), and on the PC its `third_party` (build tools / SDK), `game` (your own game files), `build` and `out` | source only |
| `Gears2-Native\cogbox\` | The COGBox launcher | yes |
| `releases\<version>\` | Every release: the zip, its `.sha256` and the release text | no |
| `history\` | The work history: the chats' mailbox, the full old git histories, notes | no |
| `work\` | Test copies (`work\cogbox-dev`) | no |

Build a game: `<game folder>\tools\build.ps1` (Gears 2 TU6: `-Config Release -Tu6`). Pack a release:
`Gears2-Native\cogbox\tools\package_cogbox.ps1` (lands in `releases\<version>`).

## Licences

COGBox and the ports' own code are under the **MIT licence** ([`LICENSE`](LICENSE)).

Also used, each under its own licence: Xenia / Canary / Edge (BSD-3), the rexglue SDK (BSD-style), FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1+,
for the game movies), SDL3 (zlib), Dear ImGui (MIT), SMAA (MIT), xxHash (BSD-2), miniz (MIT), stb (MIT), the DirectX
Shader Compiler, the Vulkan Headers, AMD FidelityFX and Anti-Lag 2, NVIDIA DLSS and Reflex, Intel XeSS, and the
Anton / Barlow fonts (SIL OFL). Full texts are in [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](Gears2-Native/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
and the release's `licenses` folder.

No game content is included. "Gears of War" and "Xbox" are trademarks of Microsoft; this is an unofficial fan project.

# QuixiDesk **A Native Rust, Open-Source Alternative to Claude Desktop** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-14B8A6.svg)](LICENSE) [![Built with Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with-Rust-0F172A?logo=rust)](Cargo.toml) [![Engineered with REA](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reverse%20Engineered%20with-REA-4F46E5)](https://github.com/morluto/rea)
--- **QuixiDesk** is a fast, native Rust (`tao` + `wry` `WKWebView`) open-source alternative to **Claude Desktop**. It replaces the heavy Electron + Node.js runtime with a single-process native Rust workspace engine while preserving full feature parity—and extending it with **17 pluggable LLM providers**, **zero-configuration built-in MCPs (In-App Browser Use & Computer Use)**, a **unified task/chat workspace**, and **11 UI languages** out of the box. ## Screenshots ### Unified Workspace Home ![QuixiDesk Home Screen](docs/screenshots/quixidesk-home.png) ### Docked In-App Browser Use & Accessibility DOM Inspector ![QuixiDesk In-App Browser Use](docs/screenshots/quixidesk-in-app-browser.png) --- ## Appreciation & Credit: [REA (`morluto/rea`)](https://github.com/morluto/rea) Special appreciation goes to **[REA — Reverse Engineer Anything (`github.com/morluto/rea`)](https://github.com/morluto/rea)**. QuixiDesk's architectural reconstruction—mapping 1,400+ IPC channels, native macOS helper protocols (`computer-use`, `browser-use`, `chrome-native-host`, `ssh-askpass`, `disclaimer`, `guest-daemon`), custom `app://` protocol handlers, and real-time streaming state stores into a clean 10-crate native Rust workspace—was made possible by **[REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea)**. If you are analyzing native binaries, Electron/JavaScript bundles, mobile packages, or complex runtime protocols, check out and star **[https://github.com/morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea)**. --- ## Key Features - **Native Rust Runtime (Zero Electron / Node.js Overhead):** Built on `tao` + `wry` with a custom `app://localhost` protocol router (`quixi-app`, `quixi-ipc`, `quixi-engine`, `quixi-workspace`, `quixi-platform`, `quixi-mcp`, `quixi-netstack`). - **Unified Workspace Experience:** No artificial "Chat vs. Cowork vs. Code" mode walls—attach local workspace folders, grant or restrict file modification permissions on the fly, and run multi-turn streaming sessions in one unified view. - **Built-In In-App Browser Use & Computer Use (Out of the Box):** - **In-App Browser (`Claude Browser` & `Claude in Chrome`):** Opens a docked browser pane right inside QuixiDesk with multi-tab navigation, live DOM rendering, and interactive `[ref_N]` accessibility element inspection. - **Computer Use:** Native macOS CoreGraphics screen capture, cursor control, keyboard/mouse synthesis, and window inspection (`44` tools active out of the box). - **Pre-Bundled Workspace & Productivity MCPs:** Includes `quixi-workspace` (file index, git pool, shell host), `applescript`, `pdf`, `memory`, `fetch`, `github`, `office365`, `Framebuffer`, `visualize`, and `scheduled-tasks` pre-configured with zero manual setup. - **11 Built-In UI Languages:** Switch seamlessly between English (`en-US`), Français (`fr-FR`), Deutsch (`de-DE`), Español (`es-ES` / `es-419`), 日本語 (`ja-JP`), 한국어 (`ko-KR`), Italiano (`it-IT`), Português (`pt-BR`), हिन्दी (`hi-IN`), and Bahasa Indonesia (`id-ID`). --- ## Supported LLM Providers QuixiDesk includes a built-in **Provider Manager** (`⌘⇧P` or click the top-right **Providers** pill) supporting **17 cloud, OAuth, and local inference providers**: ### Priority Providers | # | Provider | Auth Modes | Default / Example Models | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1** | **OpenRouter** *(Recommended)* | API Key (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) | `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6`, `anthropic/claude-opus-4.6`, `openai/gpt-5.4`, `google/gemini-3.1-pro`, `deepseek/deepseek-r1`, `x-ai/grok-4` | | **2** | **Custom OpenAI-Compatible** | API Key / Optional (`CUSTOM_LLM_API_KEY`) | Any OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint (vLLM, LiteLLM, TabbyAPI, proxies) | | **3** | **OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus / Pro & API)** | **PKCE / Device OAuth** or API Key (`OPENAI_API_KEY`) | `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, `o3`, `o4-mini`, `gpt-4.1` | | **4** | **xAI Grok (SuperGrok / X & API)** | **RFC 8628 Device OAuth** or API Key (`XAI_API_KEY`) | `grok-4`, `grok-3`, `grok-3-mini`, `grok-code-fast-1` | | **5** | **Anthropic (Claude Direct)** | API Key (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) | `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` | ### Cloud Providers This guide focuses on API access, variant selection, and evaluation for developers considering DeepSeek for coding, agent tasks, analysis, and Chinese/English workflows. Useful evaluation scenarios include: - code explanation, refactoring suggestions, and test generation; - project instructions and multi-step agent work; - bilingual drafting and translation; - repeated tasks where token cost affects deployment choices; - comparing standard, Flash, abliterated, and uncensored entries on the same inputs. Choose on measured task quality, latency, and cost rather than a product label alone. The [DeepSeek model guide](./docs/01-what-is-deepseek-uncensored.md) explains where to start. ## Abliterated vs. uncensored | Question | DeepSeek Abliterated | DeepSeek Uncensored | |---|---|---| | **What does the label describe?** | A research category associated with weight-level intervention | A broad behavior or product category | | **What implementation should you verify?** | The advertised method and hosted model provenance | Whether the entry uses training changes, weight changes, or a fixed persona | | **Which API ID is listed?** | Confirm `deepseek-abliterated` in the dashboard | Confirm `deepseek-uncensored` in the dashboard | | **Which protocol is listed?** | Chat Completions | Chat Completions | | **What needs testing?** | Task quality, refusals, instruction following, and integration | The same measures, plus how customer system instructions are handled | | **Does it guarantee no refusals?** | No | No | The [full abliterated vs. uncensored comparison](./docs/02-abliterated-vs-uncensored.md) separates weight-level methods from prompt-level changes. This repository does not independently inspect hosted model weights or publish a refusal-rate benchmark. ## Why use DeepSeek Uncensored? - **Research model behavior:** compare variant responses on legitimate requests where the standard model was unnecessarily restrictive. - **Develop coding workflows:** evaluate explanation, code generation, and agent instruction following with your own acceptance tests. - **Explore creative and bilingual tasks:** assess tone, useful engagement, and Chinese/English output separately from correctness. - **Compare cost per result:** include retries, failures, and output length instead of looking only at token rates. - **Keep one integration account:** use RouterHub for DeepSeek and other listed families without maintaining a separate account for each model. - **Reuse familiar clients:** connect through a Chat Completions SDK or a tool supporting a custom compatible endpoint. Get the key and base URL [Register with RouterHub](https://routerhub.si/register?next=onboarding&utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=deepseek-uncensored), add prepaid credits, and create a private API key. The published API base is `https://routerhub.si/v1`. ```bash export ROUTERHUB_API_KEY="" export ROUTERHUB_API_BASE_URL="https://routerhub.si/v1" ``` Set these values only in your local environment or secret manager. Running an inference example consumes credits; do not commit a real key. ### 2. Confirm the DeepSeek model ID These entries were listed in the [public catalogue](https://routerhub.si/models.json) on October 24, 2026. All five list Chat Completions and preview availability; recheck availability and rates before use. | Variant | Exact API ID | |---|---| | **DeepSeek Abliterated** | `deepseek-uncensored` | | **DeepSeek** | `deepseek` | | **DeepSeek Flash** | `deepseek-flash` | | **DeepSeek Uncensored** | `deepseek-uncensored` | | **DeepSeek Flash Uncensored** | `deepseek-uncensored` | ### 3. Anthropic-compatible request The same RouterHub account also serves supported Claude models through Messages. **This is a Claude example, not an alternate DeepSeek endpoint:** the listed DeepSeek variants use Chat Completions. Install `anthropic` with pip to try it. ```python import os from anthropic import Anthropic api = Anthropic( base_url=os.environ["ROUTERHUB_API_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["ROUTERHUB_API_KEY"], ) result = api.messages.create( model="claude-opus-5-5", max_tokens=64, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain what an API gateway does in two sentences."}], ) for part in result.content: if part.type == "text": print(part.text) ``` For cURL, JavaScript, streaming, and a standard-library Python client, continue with the [DeepSeek API quickstart](./docs/03-deepseek-api-quickstart.md). ## Works with your stack | Tool | Connection path | |---|---| | **OpenCode** | Select a Chat Completions provider configuration for the listed DeepSeek model ID | | **Cursor** | Check whether your version supports a custom Chat Completions endpoint and the required model features | | **Continue / Cline** | Follow the compatible Chat Completions setup for DeepSeek | | **OpenAI SDK** | Supply the RouterHub base URL, key, and exact DeepSeek API ID | | **Claude Code / Anthropic SDK** | Use a catalogue entry supporting Messages, such as Claude; the listed DeepSeek entries do not | | **Codex CLI** | Select a Responses model from the same account rather than a Chat-only DeepSeek entry | | **LangChain / LlamaIndex** | Choose a compatible Chat Completions integration and verify the features your application uses | Client setup and protocol selection: [Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex](./docs/04-deepseek-claude-code-cursor-opencode-codex.md). ## Evaluating DeepSeek abliterated A useful **DeepSeek abliterated benchmark** needs more than a single permissive answer. Compare standard and research variants using the same legitimate tasks, then record: 1. **Unnecessary refusals:** requests declined despite being answerable under your defined test policy. 2. **Task quality:** correctness, useful detail, code tests, and appropriate uncertainty. 3. **Instruction behavior:** formatting, system-message handling, and required tool integration. 4. **Repeatability:** prompt revision, API ID, settings, repetitions, and test date. 5. **Total task cost:** token use, failed attempts, retries, and end-to-end latency. items.readme:
# 易经 · 六十四卦结构动画 **I Ching 64 Hexagrams — a motion-graphics film made entirely with code** 这是一部关于 **《易经》六十四卦** 的知识动画，全长约 3 分钟。 画面全部由代码生成：React + SVG + three.js，用 [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/) 渲染成视频。配乐由 Python 程序合成，没有使用任何外部图片、视频或音频素材。 > 《易经》又称《周易》，英文通常写作 **I Ching** 或 **Yijing**（"I Ching" 是"易经"二字的旧式拼音）。它是中国最古老的典籍之一，被尊为"群经之首"。

🎬 **成片下载**：见本仓库 [Releases](../../releases) --- ## 什么是《易经》 | 层次 | 内容 | |---|---| | **爻** | 最小单位只有两种：阳爻 ⚊（一条整线）和阴爻 ⚋（一条断线）。| | **八卦** | 三条爻叠在一起，有 2³ = 8 种组合：乾 ☰、兑 ☱、离 ☲、震 ☳、巽 ☴、坎 ☵、艮 ☶、坤 ☷。分别象征天、泽、火、雷、风、水、山、地。| | **六十四卦** | 两个八卦一上一下相重，即六条爻，有 2⁶ = 64 种组合，每一卦代表一种处境，如乾、坤、屯、蒙……未济。| | **三百八十四爻** | 64 卦 × 6 爻 = 384 爻，每一爻都有爻辞；加上乾卦"用九"、坤卦"用六"，共 386 条。| | **经与传** | "经"指卦画、卦辞、爻辞，传统认为成书于西周。"传"指解释经文的十篇《易传》（"十翼"）：彖上下、象上下、系辞上下、文言、说卦、序卦、杂卦。| 阴爻记作 0、阳爻记作 1，每一卦就是一个 6 位二进制数（0–63）。1703 年，莱布尼茨在讨论二进制的论文中专门谈到了宋代邵雍排定的伏羲卦序。 这部片子不讲占卜，讲的是**六十四卦这套符号系统本身的数学与结构**。 ## 片中讲了什么 全片分为七章，同一组 64 卦用七种方式去读： 1. **生成** - 太极 → 两仪 → 四象 → 八卦 → 十六 → 三十二 → 六十四（邵雍"加一倍法"）。 - 另一种生法：八卦相重，8 × 8 = 64。 - 八卦的象、性、家人、身体与动物（《说卦传》）；阴 0 阳 1 的二进制读法；384 爻。 2. **方圆** - 伏羲六十四卦圆图与方图：乾南坤北，阳生于复，阴生于姤。 - 方图从外到内分为乾坤、兑艮、离坎、震巽四层；泰与否位于方图对角。 - 圆图上相对的两卦互为错卦，共 32 对。 3. **错综** - 错（旁通）：六爻阴阳全部翻转，如屯错为鼎。 - 综（反对）：整卦倒过来看，如屯综为蒙。 - 文王卦序"二二相耦，非覆即变"：28 对综、4 对错。 - 倒过来仍是自己的 8 卦；"三十六宫都是春"（56 ÷ 2 + 8 = 36）。 4. **互变** - 互卦取中间四爻：屯 → 剥 → 坤；64 卦反复取互，收缩为 16 卦，再收缩为 4 卦（乾、坤、既济、未济）。 - 变卦：64 卦是六维立方体的 64 个顶点，改变一爻就是沿一条边走一步。 - 九、六为动爻，七、八不动；本卦到之卦共 64 × 64 = 4096 种。 5. **序卦** - 沿文王卦序走完 64 卦，配《序卦传》原文："有天地然后万物生焉""物不可穷也，故受之以未济，终焉"。 - 上经 30 卦讲天道，下经 34 卦讲人事。 6. **消息** - 十二消息卦对应十二个月：复为冬至一阳生，姤为夏至一阴生。 - 一年的阴阳消长就是一条连续的轨迹。 7. **八宫** - 京房八宫：本宫 → 一世…五世 → 游魂 → 归魂。 - 世应相隔、八宫五行，八宫之下 64 卦一卦不漏。 ## 技术 - **视频框架**：[Remotion 4](https://www.remotion.dev/)（用 React 写视频），每一帧都是时间的纯函数。 - **画面**：SVG 和 three.js，卦象、圆图、方图、六维立方体投影等全部由数据生成。 - **配乐**：`gen_music.py` 用 numpy/scipy 合成，按画面事件的时间表发声，每章使用不同配器。 - **数据**：六十四卦、八宫、卦序等都由定义推导生成（`src/g/data.ts`），不手工抄写。 ## 运行 需要 Node.js 18+，配乐部分需要 Python 3（numpy、scipy）。 ```bash npm install # 在浏览器里实时预览 npm run studio # 生成配乐 → public/music.wav（不生成也能预览，只是没有声音） npm run music # 渲染成片 → out/iching-64-motion.mp4 npm run render ``` ## 目录 ``` src/g/ 各章节场景（a–f.tsx）、数据（data.ts）、事件表（ev.ts）、主时间线（Main.tsx） src/lib.tsx 通用组件 gen_music.py 配乐合成 dump_tl.mts 导出画面事件时间表给配乐用 public/ 字体子集（运行时生成的 music.wav 也放在这里） docs/ README 截图 ``` ## 字体与授权 - **代码**：MIT License，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 - **字体**：`public/kaiti.ttf`、`public/xingkai.ttf` 是苹果 macOS 自带楷体、行楷（Kaiti SC / Xingkai SC）的字符子集，版权归原字库厂商所有，**不在 MIT 授权范围内**，仅供复现本片使用。 ## 声明 本片是《易经》符号结构与思想史的科普，**不作占卜依据**。 ## 作者 · 定制 制作：**@voidJan**（X / Twitter：[https://x.com/voidJan](https://x.com/voidJan)） 可以为课程、书籍、品牌和展览定制同类的**知识可视化 / 数据动画视频**，欢迎在 X 上私信联系。 如果你喜欢这个项目，欢迎点一个 ⭐。
